what: When a trial with a single change is open in two browser tabs and the change is marked reviewed in one, clicking Mark reviewed in the other says "These 1 changes were already reviewed. This trial stays open." The sentence is new in this build's fix for walker-trial-page-02; nothing it says is untrue. The review bar's own sentences on the same page have the same fault and were not changed by this build: "Review covers all 1 changes shown above." and, once reviewed, "These 1 changes are reviewed." I ran it at both window sizes and the page showed the plural each time. The cause is that these sentences put the count before a fixed plural word instead of choosing the word by the count, as the page's other sentences do.
